metadata.name: ATM Town Attribute — Astronaut Body
metadata.description: Official transferable ATM Town body attribute for the ATM character. Equipping Astronaut Body gives the ATM character a low-gravity jump profile: 4× normal jump height and 2.7× normal jump duration, with existing Bounce and Jetpack synergies preserved.

provenance.creator: ATM Town
provenance.source: ATM Town official attribute catalog and live gameplay constants
